text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Rectory Road, between Coulter Avenue and Windal Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Rectory Road to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only on a street name basis from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (east) side of Rectory Road, between Coulter Avenue and Windal Avenue.
